name: Trailer Fetcher
description: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.
overview: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.

versions.changelog: Cookie file upload (for authenticated/age-restricted YouTube access) and per-library scan scoping. Trailer search/download and folder migration logic ported from the standalone script still lands in a follow-up release - this build is for settings/wiring testing only, it does not fetch trailers yet.
